profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Toast
profile.summary: As a full stack engineer, I operate at the crux of creativity and problem solving. I bring a deep and abiding love for documentation to my work, as well as a goal of making every developer on a team feel fully supported. In my spare time, I perform and teach dances of the Jazz Era, so if you want to learn the Charleston, I'm here to help!

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description: Driving the technical roadmap and delivering on our team's goals

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Full stack engineer on the Employee Cloud team, making tips more transparent and intuitive

positions.title: Dancer
positions.description: I perform and teach dances of the American Jazz Era, including Lindy Hop, Charleston, Balboa, and solo jazz. I've had the privilege of performing at Carnegie Hall, Lincoln Center’s Midsummer Night’s Swing and New York's Jazz Age Lawn Party, among others, and I continue to seek new opportunities to learn more about the histories and languages of social dance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Project lead and individual contributor for applications in Ruby on Rails, React and Swift. I work closely with designers and fellow developers to produce bespoke features for both our flagship consumer products and internal tools.

positions.title: Assistant Marketing Manager
positions.description:
• Produced sitemaps and wireframes for new and legacy brand sites, worked with web developers to ensure production specs were met, and grew site traffic by up to 200% within a month of launch 
• Spearheaded innovative, multi-pronged marketing campaigns for over a dozen New York Times bestselling authors, including Daniel Pink, David Epstein, Steven Johnson, and Deborah Harkness
• Lead marketer for over 40 projects annually across 4 cross-functional teams with differing demands and go-to-market timelines
• Leveraged user research, data analysis, and iterative ad testing to surface consumer insights, build audience personas and shape marketing initiatives 
• Communicated campaign strategy and progress to stakeholders throughout the life of a project, including pitches, post-mortems, case studies, and trainings

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
• Managed a portfolio of 15 projects across three imprints, while contributing to 20+ additional titles
• Identified a major pre-order campaign opportunity and successfully negotiated a multi-platform paid and organic campaign that landed a book on the New York Times bestseller list
• Provided authors with personalized, data-driven tactics to improve engagement on websites, newsletters and social media
• Produced and tracked digital assets for online and B2B campaigns in collaboration with in-house design team
• Cultivated partnerships with brands and influencers in overlapping markets

positions.title: Marketing Assistant
positions.description:
• Took ownership of a title where I saw an opportunity for growth, and drove sales to reach 220% of initial projections
• Coordinated rapid, reactive social media marketing and advertising efforts for growth titles
• Developed and amplified authors’ online presence, including website design and social media strategy

projects.title: Lexi: Visual Thesaurus
projects.description: With an intuitive user experience and minimalist design, Lexi allows users to trace a clear visual and verbal path from any root word through a growing network of synonyms. Built with vanilla Javascript, the D3 data visualization library, an Express.js server, and the Merriam-Webster API.

projects.title: Spirited
projects.description: Spirited was developed over a 10-day sprint, using Rails as a backend API and React with Redux for the frontend. Inspired by the popular wine-rating web app "Vivino," Spirited lets users can rate and review their favorite whiskies, and search our database to discover new drams.

publications.title: Beholden to the Bear: The Political Economy of European Natural Gas Trade with Russia
publications.publisher: Journal of the Claremont-UC Undergraduate Research Conference on the European Union · Apr 10, 2010
